title: Cranial modification told to have been ordered by the gods

tellings.quote: one group uh a paper by gson and gson from 1995 where they interviewed them and said why why do you do this and they said because our ancestors were instructed by the gods to do this

plain: Peoples around the world, including the Maya, reshaped their children's skulls, and when one group was asked why, they said their ancestors had been told to do it by the gods. The anthropologist Mike Masters gives this from a 1995 paper by the researchers Gerszten and Gerszten, who interviewed the group. He raises it because it would suggest the practice began as imitation of visitors seen as gods.
